LOC_PATCH_QUESTION_CONTENT.source: 把笃定或赞叹改成反问。
LOC_PATCH_QUESTION_CONTENT.zh_CN: 把笃定或赞叹改成反问。
LOC_PATCH_QUESTION_CONTENT.en: Turn reassurance or praise into a question.

LOC_PATCH_QUESTION_DESCRIPTION.source: 适用于 This is Fine 和 Why is this so PEAK，让原本笃定的表达产生疑问。
LOC_PATCH_QUESTION_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 适用于凡尔赛和 OK boomer。让假谦虚变成求夸的反问，或在回绝说教前问一句“讲完了吗？”
LOC_PATCH_QUESTION_DESCRIPTION.en: For 凡尔赛 and OK boomer. Turn false modesty into a question seeking praise, or ask 'Finished?' before dismissing a lecture.

LOC_PATCH_COMPARISON_CONTENT.source: 把预期与实际放在一起对照。
LOC_PATCH_COMPARISON_CONTENT.en: Put two situations side by side for comparison.

LOC_PATCH_COMPARISON_DESCRIPTION.source: 仅适用于 Why is this so PEAK，用预期与实际的落差构成评价。
LOC_PATCH_COMPARISON_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 适用于三个起点。凡尔赛对照别人和自己的努力；Nobody 对照别人离场和自己继续讲；OK boomer 对照过去和现在的处境。
LOC_PATCH_COMPARISON_DESCRIPTION.en: For all three starters. 凡尔赛 contrasts other people's effort with your own; Nobody contrasts others leaving with you talking on; OK boomer contrasts conditions then and now.

LOC_PATCH_EXIT_CONTENT.source: 允许参与者退出这轮接梗。
LOC_PATCH_EXIT_CONTENT.zh_CN: 允许参与者退出这轮接梗。
LOC_PATCH_EXIT_CONTENT.en: Let participants sit this round out.

LOC_PATCH_EXIT_DESCRIPTION.source: 仅适用于 67，保留不参与或结束接梗的选择，不给数字附加含义。
LOC_PATCH_EXIT_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 适用于 Nobody 和 OK boomer。Nobody 先装续写，再允许别人不接话；OK boomer 可以直接声明这轮对话结束。
LOC_PATCH_EXIT_DESCRIPTION.en: For Nobody and OK boomer. With Nobody, add Continue first, then let others sit out. With OK boomer, explicitly end the conversation.

LOC_PATCH_EXPLANATION_CONTENT.zh_CN: 为这句话补上一句具体理由。
LOC_PATCH_EXPLANATION_CONTENT.en: Add a concrete reason for the statement.

LOC_PATCH_EXPLANATION_DESCRIPTION.source: 适用于 This is Fine 和 Why is this so PEAK，补足读者理解句子所需的情境。
LOC_PATCH_EXPLANATION_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 适用于三个起点。为凡尔赛的假遗憾、Nobody 停不下来的分享，或 OK boomer 对说教的回绝，补上一句具体理由。
LOC_PATCH_EXPLANATION_DESCRIPTION.en: For all three starters. Add a concrete reason for 凡尔赛's apparent disappointment, Nobody's unstoppable sharing, or OK boomer's refusal to hear a lecture.

LOC_PATCH_CONTINUATION_CONTENT.source: 把下一轮接梗留给别人。
LOC_PATCH_CONTINUATION_CONTENT.zh_CN: 把下一轮接梗留给别人。
LOC_PATCH_CONTINUATION_CONTENT.en: Leave the next turn to someone else.

LOC_PATCH_CONTINUATION_DESCRIPTION.source: 仅适用于 67，用轮流接梗延续参与，不把它改造成观点或口号。
LOC_PATCH_CONTINUATION_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 仅适用于 Nobody。在自己的自嘲后邀请别人也讲一次“没人问却忍不住说”的经历，还可以搭配退出补丁。
LOC_PATCH_CONTINUATION_DESCRIPTION.en: For Nobody only. Follow your self-mockery by inviting others to share something they explain even when nobody asks. Can be combined with Exit.

LOC_ROUTE_FINE_EXPLANATION.source: The room is on fire, but this is fine.
LOC_ROUTE_FINE_EXPLANATION.zh_CN: 房间都着火了，不过一切都好。
LOC_ROUTE_FINE_EXPLANATION.en: The room is on fire, but this is fine.

LOC_ROUTE_FINE_EXPLANATION_QUESTION.source: The room is on fire. Is this really fine?
LOC_ROUTE_FINE_EXPLANATION_QUESTION.zh_CN: 房间都着火了。这真的没问题吗？
LOC_ROUTE_FINE_EXPLANATION_QUESTION.en: The room is on fire. Is this really fine?

LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_COMPARISON.source: I expected good. Why is this so PEAK?
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_COMPARISON.zh_CN: 我只期待它不错，怎么会这么神？
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_COMPARISON.en: I expected good. Why is this so PEAK?

LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_EXPLANATION.source: Why is this so PEAK? It is better than I ever expected.
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_EXPLANATION.zh_CN: 怎么会这么神？它比我期待的好太多了。
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_EXPLANATION.en: Why is this so PEAK? It is better than I ever expected.

LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_COMPARISON_QUESTION.source: They called this PEAK. Is it really?
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_COMPARISON_QUESTION.zh_CN: 他们说这是巅峰。真的是吗？
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_COMPARISON_QUESTION.en: They called this PEAK. Is it really?

LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_EXPLANATION_QUESTION.source: Is this really PEAK, or am I just caught up in the excitement?
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_EXPLANATION_QUESTION.zh_CN: 这真的是巅峰，还是我只是一时上头？
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_EXPLANATION_QUESTION.en: Is this really PEAK, or am I just caught up in the excitement?

LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_EXPLANATION_COMPARISON.source: I expected something good, but this is the best thing I have seen.
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_EXPLANATION_COMPARISON.zh_CN: 我只期待它不错，结果它是我见过最棒的。
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_EXPLANATION_COMPARISON.en: I expected something good, but this is the best thing I have seen.

LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_ALL.source: They called this the best thing ever. Is it really PEAK, or just better than we expected?
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_ALL.zh_CN: 他们说这是史上最佳。它真是巅峰，还是只比我们预期的好？
LOC_ROUTE_PEAK_ALL.en: They called this the best thing ever. Is it really PEAK, or just better than we expected?

LOC_ROUTE_67_EXIT.source: Six seven. Or sit this one out.
LOC_ROUTE_67_EXIT.en: Six seven. Or sit this one out.

LOC_ROUTE_67_EXIT_CONTINUATION.source: Six seven—take a turn or sit this one out.
LOC_ROUTE_67_EXIT_CONTINUATION.zh_CN: 六七，接一轮，或者这回先歇着。
LOC_ROUTE_67_EXIT_CONTINUATION.en: Six seven—take a turn or sit this one out.

LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_NINGHUA_COMMENTARY.en: “From a lofty roof the waters fall; short paths diverge. All my life, I seek only the art.” — Wang Liu, poet of the Ruo dynasty.

LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SHIOHARA_DESCRIPTION.source: 汐原的通行语言，街头传闻与日常寒暄在这里交汇。
LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SHIOHARA_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 汐原的通行语言，街头传闻、日常寒暄都用它来讲。
LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SHIOHARA_DESCRIPTION.en: The common language of Shiohara, where street rumours meet everyday conversation.

LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SHIOHARA_COMMENTARY.source: 潮声带走半句话，另一半留给听的人。
LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SHIOHARA_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 话留半句，余下的让听的人自己接。
LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SHIOHARA_COMMENTARY.en: Leave half the sentence for the listener to supply.

LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SEOWON_DESCRIPTION.source: 瑞原的通行语言，连接城市里的讲述者与听众。
LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SEOWON_DESCRIPTION.zh_CN: 瑞原的通行语言，城市里的人用它讲故事，也听别人讲。
LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SEOWON_DESCRIPTION.en: The common language of Seowon, connecting the city’s storytellers and listeners.

LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SEOWON_COMMENTARY.source: 同一句话，走过不同街区，就有了不同的回声。
LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SEOWON_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 同一句话传过不同街区，各处的人也会接出不同的意思。
LOC_CARD_LANGUAGE_SEOWON_COMMENTARY.en: The same words can be heard differently from one neighbourhood to the next.

LOC_CARD_GROUP_COMMUTERS_COMMENTARY.source: 人们在通勤路上交换消息，也交换一天的疲惫。
LOC_CARD_GROUP_COMMUTERS_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 通勤路上，人们交换消息，也聊起一天的疲惫。
LOC_CARD_GROUP_COMMUTERS_COMMENTARY.en: On the commute, people share news and talk about the day's fatigue.

LOC_CARD_GROUP_STUDENTS_COMMENTARY.source: 课堂之外，总有另一套解释世界的说法。
LOC_CARD_GROUP_STUDENTS_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 课堂之外，学生也有自己解释世界的说法。
LOC_CARD_GROUP_STUDENTS_COMMENTARY.en: Beyond the classroom, students have their own ways of explaining the world.

LOC_CARD_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_COMMENTARY.source: 一张海报、一场演出，都可能成为下一段共同记忆。
LOC_CARD_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 一张海报、一场演出，都可能让人们留下共同的记忆。
LOC_CARD_GROUP_CULTURE_FANS_COMMENTARY.en: A poster or a performance may give people a memory to share.

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_POLICY_COMMENTARY.source: 公告贴上墙后，讨论才刚开始。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_POLICY_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 公告贴出来了，讨论才刚开始。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_POLICY_COMMENTARY.en: Once the notice goes up, the discussion begins.

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_COST_OF_LIVING_COMMENTARY.source: 账单上的数字，也是餐桌上的话题。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_COST_OF_LIVING_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 生活开销的数字一摆出来，餐桌上就有了话题。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_COST_OF_LIVING_COMMENTARY.en: Figures on a bill become something to talk about around the table.

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_WORK_COMMENTARY.source: 工作结束了，关于工作的故事还没有。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_WORK_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 下班了，白天工作的故事还没讲完。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_WORK_COMMENTARY.en: The workday is over; the stories about it aren't.

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_PLATFORM_TOOLS_COMMENTARY.source: 工具改变消息的去向，也改变说话的习惯。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_PLATFORM_TOOLS_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 工具换了，消息走的路和人们说话的习惯也跟着变。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_PLATFORM_TOOLS_COMMENTARY.en: Tools change where messages travel and how people speak.

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_SPORT_COMMENTARY.source: 终场哨响之后，争论仍在继续。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_SPORT_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 终场哨响了，关于输赢的争论还在加时。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_SPORT_COMMENTARY.en: The final whistle blows, and the argument goes into extra time.

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_EDUCATION_COMMENTARY.source: 每一代人都在重新回答：什么值得学习？
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_EDUCATION_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 每一代人都在重新问：什么值得学？
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_EDUCATION_COMMENTARY.en: Each generation asks again: what is worth learning?

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_IDENTITY_COMMENTARY.source: 人们用一个称呼，寻找彼此的位置。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_IDENTITY_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 人们借着一个称呼，认出自己和彼此的位置。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_IDENTITY_COMMENTARY.en: With a name, people find their place among one another.

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_COMMENTARY.source: 表达抵达他人之前，总要经过语言。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 表达要抵达别人，总要先经过语言。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_LANGUAGE_COMMENTARY.en: Before an expression reaches anyone else, it passes through language.

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_ENTERTAINMENT_COMMENTARY.source: 掌声散去后，总有一句台词留下。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_ENTERTAINMENT_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 掌声停了，一句台词还会留在人们的日常闲聊里。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_ENTERTAINMENT_COMMENTARY.en: After the applause fades, a line can stay in everyday conversation.

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_ARCHIVE_COMMENTARY.source: 被保存的不只是纸，还有当时的目光。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_ARCHIVE_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 档案留住纸页，也留下当时人们看待事物的方式。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_ARCHIVE_COMMENTARY.en: An archive keeps the paper and how people saw things at the time.

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_TRUST_COMMENTARY.source: 一句话能走多远，有时取决于是谁说的。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_TRUST_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 同一句话能传多远，有时还得看是谁说的。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_TRUST_COMMENTARY.en: How far words travel can depend on who speaks them.

LOC_CARD_TOPIC_COMMUNITY_COMMENTARY.source: 熟悉的街角，让陌生的消息有了落脚处。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_COMMUNITY_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 熟悉的社区里，陌生消息也有了接着聊的由头。
LOC_CARD_TOPIC_COMMUNITY_COMMENTARY.en: A familiar community gives people a way to talk about unfamiliar news.

LOC_CARD_FREEDOM_COMMENTARY.source: 让表达留出自行选择的余地。
LOC_CARD_FREEDOM_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 说话时留点余地，也让别人能自己选择。
LOC_CARD_FREEDOM_COMMENTARY.en: Leave room in the phrasing for people to make their own choice.

LOC_CARD_AUTHORITY_COMMENTARY.source: 秩序的声音，要求一个明确的方向。
LOC_CARD_AUTHORITY_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 讲秩序的话，要给人一个明确的方向。
LOC_CARD_AUTHORITY_COMMENTARY.en: The voice of order asks for a clear direction.

LOC_CARD_EQUALITY_COMMENTARY.source: 同一张桌旁，不该只有一种声音。
LOC_CARD_EQUALITY_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 同一张桌旁，也该听见不同的声音。
LOC_CARD_EQUALITY_COMMENTARY.en: More than one voice belongs at the same table.

LOC_CARD_HIERARCHY_COMMENTARY.source: 位置不同，听见的话也不同。
LOC_CARD_HIERARCHY_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 站的位置不同，传到耳边的话也不同。
LOC_CARD_HIERARCHY_COMMENTARY.en: From different positions, different words reach you.

LOC_CARD_SINCERE_COMMENTARY.source: 有时，一句话就只是它字面的意思。
LOC_CARD_SINCERE_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 有时，一句话说的就是字面上的意思。
LOC_CARD_SINCERE_COMMENTARY.en: Sometimes a sentence means just what it says.

LOC_CARD_IRONIC_COMMENTARY.source: 话说到一半，另一半藏在语气里。
LOC_CARD_IRONIC_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 话只说出一半意思，剩下的得听语气。
LOC_CARD_IRONIC_COMMENTARY.en: Half the meaning is in the words; the rest is in the tone.

LOC_CARD_SUPPORT_COMMENTARY.source: 点头也会让一种说法继续流传。
LOC_CARD_SUPPORT_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 点头赞同，也能让一种说法接着传下去。
LOC_CARD_SUPPORT_COMMENTARY.en: A nod of support can keep an expression moving.

LOC_CARD_OPPOSITION_COMMENTARY.source: 不赞同，也是加入对话的一种方式。
LOC_CARD_OPPOSITION_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 反对一句话，也是在回应它。
LOC_CARD_OPPOSITION_COMMENTARY.en: Disagreement is a way of joining the conversation too.

LOC_CARD_MODULE_STANCE_COMMENTARY.source: 问号一落下，熟悉的话就变了声调。
LOC_CARD_MODULE_STANCE_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 同一个问号，有人用来等夸奖，有人用来催对方讲完。
LOC_CARD_MODULE_STANCE_COMMENTARY.en: One person uses a question mark to wait for praise; another uses it to hurry a lecturer along.

LOC_CARD_MODULE_RELATION_COMMENTARY.source: 多一个听众，旧话也可能有了新意。
LOC_CARD_MODULE_RELATION_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 别人熬夜复习，你说自己没准备。两句话并排放，那点小得意就露出来了。
LOC_CARD_MODULE_RELATION_COMMENTARY.en: Everyone else studied all night; you say you didn't prepare. Set those lines side by side, and the pride is hard to hide.

LOC_CARD_MODULE_RITUAL_COMMENTARY.source: 重复让一句话变成大家都认得的暗号。
LOC_CARD_MODULE_RITUAL_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 别人可以停在这里，你也可以说一句“到这里吧”。
LOC_CARD_MODULE_RITUAL_COMMENTARY.en: You can let someone else sit out, or be the one to say, 'Let's leave it there.'

LOC_CARD_MODULE_BOUNDARY_COMMENTARY.source: 语言的边界，有时也是新故事的入口。
LOC_CARD_MODULE_BOUNDARY_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 补一句为什么，别人就更容易听懂你在得意什么，又在烦什么。
LOC_CARD_MODULE_BOUNDARY_COMMENTARY.en: Add a reason, and people can better understand what you're proud of or fed up with.

LOC_CARD_MODULE_SHARED_WORLD_COMMENTARY.source: 当细节被共同记住，世界就有了轮廓。
LOC_CARD_MODULE_SHARED_WORLD_COMMENTARY.zh_CN: 自己的故事讲完了，把下一句留给也有同感的人。
LOC_CARD_MODULE_SHARED_WORLD_COMMENTARY.en: Once your story is told, leave the next line to someone who knows the feeling.

LOC_GUIDANCE_FIRST_COMPETITOR.source: 地图上出现了别人的模因。它们也在争取注意力；不同颜色区分家族，空心圈表示出生或投放位置，实心点是各国采用人数的抽样。
LOC_GUIDANCE_FIRST_COMPETITOR.zh_CN: 啊哦，地图上出现了别人的模因，它们也在争取注意力。不同颜色代表不同家族，空心圈是起点，实心点是各地采用的人数……如果离你还很远，大可不必担心。
LOC_GUIDANCE_FIRST_COMPETITOR.en: Another meme has appeared on the map. It competes for attention too. Colors distinguish families; hollow circles mark origins or launch sites, and solid dots sample adoption by country.

LOC_GUIDANCE_FIRST_MUTATION.source: 你的模因已经被别人改写了。回到编辑页时，先看自己的最终表达，再决定下一次修改。外部突变有自己的来源和传播轨迹；它不会自动改掉你手里的原稿。
LOC_GUIDANCE_FIRST_MUTATION.zh_CN: 这也是不可避免的……你的模因已经被别人改写了。回到编辑页时，先看自己的最终表达，再决定是否要修改。或者，你也可以接受这个世界自己的运转？
LOC_GUIDANCE_FIRST_MUTATION.en: Someone has remixed your meme. Here in the editor, check your own final expression before deciding what to change next. An external mutation has its own origin and propagation history; it does not automatically replace your draft.

LOC_GUIDANCE_CHOOSE_STARTER.source: 请选择一份起始模因，预览后确认。
LOC_GUIDANCE_CHOOSE_STARTER.zh_CN: 请选择一份起始模因，预览后确认。
LOC_GUIDANCE_CHOOSE_STARTER.en: Choose a starting meme, then confirm your preview.

LOC_WAR_ACTIVE_STATUS.source: 第三次世界大战已开始，人口正在减少
LOC_WAR_ACTIVE_STATUS.zh_CN: 第三次世界大战已开始，人口正在减少
LOC_WAR_ACTIVE_STATUS.en: World War III has begun. Populations are falling.

LOC_WAR_END_STATUS.source: 传播停止，已无存活的人类载体
LOC_WAR_END_STATUS.zh_CN: 传播归于寂静，本局记录封存
LOC_WAR_END_STATUS.en: Transmission has fallen silent. This run is sealed away.

LOC_WAR_NO_REVISION.source: 战争开始或本局结束后无法继续编辑或研究，请开始新局
LOC_WAR_NO_REVISION.zh_CN: 本局的编辑和研究已经停止，请开始新局继续创作
LOC_WAR_NO_REVISION.en: Editing and research have ended for this run. Start a new run to keep creating.

LOC_INDEPENDENT_RUN_COMPLETE.source: 本局的故事已经落在纸上。
LOC_INDEPENDENT_RUN_COMPLETE.zh_CN: 本局的故事已经落在纸上。
LOC_INDEPENDENT_RUN_COMPLETE.en: This run has found its story on paper.

LOC_GUIDANCE_DEVIATION.source: 你的模因会随着时间、事件和你的编辑逐渐偏离原意，当偏移度超过50%时，它会变成一种新的模因──不再受到你的管控。如果你想要避免这一点，可以尝试避免修改过多的原模因，或者点一些“传播”节点以增强你模因的包容度。
LOC_GUIDANCE_DEVIATION.zh_CN: 注意一下这条线。随着时间、事件和你自己的修改，模因会慢慢偏离原意；一旦偏移度超过 50%，它就会独立出去，不再受你管控了。想避免这一点的话，平时别改动太多原模因，或者去传播页点一些提升包容度的节点。
LOC_GUIDANCE_DEVIATION.en: Your meme gradually drifts from its original meaning through time, events and your edits. Above 50 percent deviation it becomes a new meme beyond your control. To avoid this, keep more of the original meme or research Transmission nodes to increase its tolerance.
